name: ui-evidence
description: Verifies UI behaviour in a browser through the Playwright MCP and leaves evidence a reviewer can trust: agreed test cases, a WebM video with one chapter per case recorded safely (after login, no secrets on camera, PII masked, always stopped), DOM reads before and after each action, screenshots, a README with PASS / FAIL / not covered and a timeline. Records natively with the MCP's video tools or through a script. Ships a guard hook that lets evidence videos and scripts through without a prompt and asks for any other Playwright code, tracing or annotation.
